mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 AM, here is today's balanced dish: skies are clear near Badger Ridge Middle School with a temperature of 61 degrees and we are seeing a Third Quarter moon.

City operations are steady as we continue to track engineering service reports from AECOM, and the Senior Center is inviting residents to sign up for free 30-minute rides on their tri-shaw bikes along the Military Ridge State Trail.
Today is a great day to get active with Yoga at Insight Wellness, enjoy live music at the Concerts in the Park event, or test your knowledge at Hop Haus Trivia.
In our weekly police report, on Tuesday, an officer located a vehicle in Fireman's Park after hours which led to the arrest of a man on an outstanding warrant.
Today's flavor of the day is the delightful Chocolate Caramel Twist. Since the restaurant is currently closed, make sure to stop by when they open their doors at 10 AM to enjoy your treat.
